subject: Warm pass: NexaLabs implementation (RLW-2118) — ownership & kickoff
messages:
From: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>
To: CS Team <cs-team@redwood.com>; Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>; Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Warm pass: NexaLabs implementation (RLW-2118) — ownership & kickoff

Hi team,

Wrapping up the sales side for NexaLabs (RLW-2118) — below is a compact handoff to get implementation scheduled. Key asks up front: confirm primary CS owner, confirm technical lead for network/connectivity, and agree on a kickoff window next week.

Deal summary (quick):
- Product: Redwood Dedicated (3 reserved GPUs, NVLink) + Private networking (VPC peering)
- Committed start: May 3rd (target go-live: June 14)
- Billing: annual committed (procurement has an invoice cadence note below)
- Primary contacts at NexaLabs: Jordan Price (Engineering lead), Ava Morales (Product owner), procurement@nexalabs.com

Expectations from CS:
- Kickoff workshop to cover environment onboarding, cert/key exchange, SRE runbooks, and acceptance criteria
- Delivery of an environment readiness checklist and a staging smoke test plan
- Weekly syncs during sprint 0, decreasing cadence after acceptance

Notes / Known risks:
- NexaLabs requires IP allowlists and an on-prem connector for one pilot dataset — Vivek will lead technical prep
- Procurement asked for SOC2 evidence and an initial SOW copy (attached)
- They expect a kickoff meeting within 5 business days after our primary owner is assigned

Attachments: NexaLabs_SOW_v1.pdf; env_requirements.xlsx
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/1234567
Confluence playbook draft: https://redwood.atlassian.net/l/c/NEXA-implementation-playbook

Suggested owners (open for change):
- CS lead (primary): Mina Haddad
- Technical lead (integration/infra): Vivek Kulkarni
- Account PM (post-sale): Ben Carter

Action items: please reply with: 1) confirm owners, 2) available kickoff windows (May 3–7 preferred), 3) any additional pre-kickoff blockers.

Thanks — Priya
--
Priya Natarajan
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Thanks for the concise handoff, Priya.

I agree with Mina as CS lead and Vivek as technical lead. I'll serve as the account PM during the SOW phase and then transition custody after acceptance.

Kickoff availability: May 4 or May 5 (morning PT) both work for me.

Small ask: can we get a short note in the SOW that clarifies our rollback policy during the pilot? Procurement flagged that earlier in the demo.

Hi Jordan / Ava —

Thanks again for the partnership and for signing. I wanted to introduce Mina (CS lead) and Vivek (technical lead) who will run the implementation. Mina will lead the kickoff and owns delivery of acceptance criteria; Vivek will run the infra/network side and the staging smoke tests. Ben will be your PM during the pre-sign and SOW adjustments.

Proposed kickoff windows (pick one):
- May 4, 09:00–10:00 PT
- May 5, 10:00–11:00 PT

Immediate items for your team prior to kickoff:
1) Confirm a list of public IPs to allowlist (or let us know if you prefer to use a VPN tunnel).
2) Review the attached SOW and list any redlines — procurement@ will loop in the finance team for invoicing.
3) If you have a security questionnaire, send it over; we’ll attach SOC2 docs for initial review.

Attachments: NexaLabs_SOW_v1.pdf; env_requirements.xlsx

If May 4 works, Mina will send a calendar invite and pre-read. Looking forward to getting started.

Best,
Priya
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
